WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as employee_count 
  FROM Employee 
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(employee_count) as total_employees,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM grouped
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    g.ReportsTo,
    g.employee_count,
    CAST(g.employee_count AS REAL) / t.total_employees as share,
    1.0 / t.num_groups as avg_share
  FROM grouped g, totals t
)
SELECT 
  ReportsTo,
  employee_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as difference_from_avg
FROM with_shares
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
